name: grandma-play
description: 奶奶的游戏屋 —— 家庭专用网页小游戏平台（远程联机）

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p server && tsc -p client
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
